title: Field blocks for Berlin / Brandenburg, Germany
description:
A field block (German: "Feldblock") is a contiguous agricultural area surrounded by permanent boundaries, which is cultivated by one or more farmers with one or more crops, is fully or partially set aside or is fully or partially taken out of production.

This collection holds 1 edition (2026), one GeoParquet file per year under `year=<year>/` (hive layout). Read them all at once with the partition glob `s3://ftw/harmonized-field-data/de_bb_block/year=*/*.parquet` (S3 through the Source Cooperative proxy, endpoint `https://data.source.coop`; plain https cannot expand `*`); the `data` asset is a copy of the latest edition (2026). Geometries are kept in the source CRS (EPSG:25833). Converted with [fiboa-cli](https://github.com/fiboa/cli) into the [fiboa](https://github.com/fiboa/specification) schema; tested queries are in the collection's [AGENTS.md](https://source.coop/ftw/harmonized-field-data/de_bb_block/AGENTS.md).

Boundaries are declared: they come from farmers' subsidy applications, or from the parcel register built on those declarations.

table:columns.name: tk10
table:columns.description: Carried over from the source column `TK10_BLATT`; the publisher documents no meaning for it.

table:columns.name: hbn
table:columns.description: Carried over from the source column `HBN_KAT`; the publisher documents no meaning for it.

table:columns.name: net_area
table:columns.description: Carried over from the source column `FL_NETTO`; the publisher documents no meaning for it.

table:columns.name: metrics:area
table:columns.description: Area of the field, in square meters (m²). Must be > 0 and <= 1,000,000,000. ([spec](https://github.com/fiboa/specification/blob/main/core/README.md))

table:columns.name: flik
table:columns.description: The area identifier (FLIK code) is a 16-character string. ([spec](https://github.com/fiboa/flik-extension/blob/main/README.md))

table:columns.name: kreis_nr
table:columns.description: Carried over from the source column `KREIS_NR`; the publisher documents no meaning for it.

table:columns.name: geometry
table:columns.description: A geometry that reflects the footprint of the field, usually a Polygon. Stored in the source CRS (see `proj:code`), not reprojected. ([spec](https://github.com/fiboa/specification/blob/main/core/README.md))

table:columns.name: bbox
table:columns.type: struct<xmin: double, ymin: double, xmax: double, ymax: double>
table:columns.description: The bounding box of the field. Per-feature covering column (GeoParquet 1.1), in the source CRS. ([spec](https://github.com/fiboa/specification/blob/main/core/README.md))

partition:keys.name: year
partition:keys.description: Edition year of the source dataset (the converter variant). Not a column in the files; DuckDB adds it with hive_partitioning=true. Expand the glob through S3 (endpoint data.source.coop, path style); plain https has no listing.

data.title: Germany, Berlin/Brandenburg (blocks) — latest edition (2026) (GeoParquet)
data.description: Byte-identical copy of `year=2026/de_bb_block.parquet`, kept at a stable path so `*/latest/*.parquet` selects the newest edition of every collection.

style-field-size.title: Field size (ha)
style-field-size.description: Fields shaded light to dark by area in hectares (metrics:area / 10 000). Stops at 1, 2, 5, 20 ha, the nice values nearest this dataset's 20th/40th/60th/80th percentiles so each class holds a similar share of fields.

style-outline.title: Field boundaries
style-outline.description: Every field in one colour with a thin outline; for reading the boundaries themselves.
